create_worker_queues: create WorkerQueues with N environments to set up batched queues for RL worker communication
create_rollout_early_ends: create RolloutEarlyEnds with a multiprocessing context to track shared rollout termination steps and time
create_inference_worker_sync: create InferenceWorkerSync with a multiprocessing context and worker count to coordinate inference worker barriers and events
build_dispatch_table: build a dispatch table from a task enum by calling ProcessBase.build_dispatch_table to map tasks to handler methods
spawn_worker_base: spawn a WorkerBase subprocess from a ProcessBase subclass with lifecycle control via close and join methods
